messages:
patricia: Hi all — quick company-wide update: Redwood will observe Juneteenth as a company-paid holiday starting this year (Juneteenth 2026). Details below about hub closures, travel guidance, and a small volunteer stipend option. Please read and DM People Ops with questions.

eldon: Awesome news, thanks Pat! Are all global offices closed that day or just US hubs?

patricia: Good Q — US hubs (SF, PDX, NYC) will be closed on the observed date. For international offices: APAC and EMEA teams can choose either the local public holiday or Juneteenth as a floating holiday (your manager and People Ops will coordinate). We want to be flexible for global coverage.

noor: If my team has customer commitments, how should we staff?

people-ops: coverage-note: Business-critical teams should publish a light on-call rota. We ask teams to limit coverage to essential functions only (SRE, payments, frontline support). Team leads: please post your planned coverage schedule by EOD Fri. People Ops will auto-approve up to 8 hours of compensatory time for eligible contributors.

emma: Travel question  I have a flight into SF that week for a customer meeting. Is travel blacked out around the holiday?

patricia: Short answer: no hard blackout. Guidance: avoid scheduling non-critical travel the business day immediately before or after Juneteenth to reduce churn. If travel is essential, please coordinate with your manager and travel-team. Travel reimbursement policy applies as usual; tag Expensify receipts with "juneteenth-travel-2026".

eldon: Are offices physically locked? Will people with badge access still be able to come in?

facilities: Facilities: US hubs will be closed to general access but badge access remains for approved essential staff. If you need badge access for critical work, DM facilities with justification and dates. Building services (security, cleaning) will run a reduced schedule. Catering deliveries will not be accepted unless pre-approved.

noor: Any volunteering / community events tied to the day?

patricia: Yes  we27re offering a volunteer stipend: Up to 4 paid volunteer hours (per employee) for Juneteenth community service, plus a $50 microgrant if your team organizes a sanctioned volunteer event. Sign-ups via the Volunteering page; People Ops will confirm eligible activities.

ops-bot: calendar-update: Juneteenth (company-observed) event added to SF/PDX/NYC calendars. Global floating-holiday option added to personal holiday settings.

emma: If I take Juneteenth as my floating day in EMEA, does that count against local public holidays?

people-ops: It will count as a company holiday (no PTO deduction) but coordinate with your manager for local coverage. People Ops will reconcile regional holiday balances in payroll during the next cycle.

eldon: What about contractors / vendors? Are they paid out or expected to follow office closure?

people-ops: Contractors: we will treat company-paid holidays per existing contract terms. If you manage vendors, please review SOWs and coordinate with Finance for any vendor holiday coverage. No automatic changes to contractor billing.

noor: Shuttle / commuter impact?

facilities: Shuttle-update: SF/PDX commuter shuttles will run on a Sunday/holiday reduced schedule (two morning and two evening runs) for essential staff. Please check the shuttle calendar. Parking garages will remain operational but lobby services will be limited.

emma: Are managers expected to approve volunteer hours?

people-ops: Managers: quick approval flow in the volunteer signup form. If you27re unavailable, People Ops can proxy-approve for team-wide events.

patricia: A few process notes: 1) If you use the volunteer stipend, submit the short confirmation form within 7 days after the event, 2) travel receipts for any Juneteenth-related bookings go to Expensify with "juneteenth-travel-2026", 3) urgent infra work: ops leads please coordinate backup.

eldon: Will there be any changes to our diversity/inclusion programming tied to the day?

patricia: Yes  we'll run a company town-hall the Monday after Juneteenth with invited guest speakers, a resource pack, and optional learning modules. Attendance is optional; sessions will be recorded. We'll post the RSVP link next month.

noor: Thanks — one last: if someone needs an exception to take the floating day on another date because of personal reasons, what's the process?

people-ops: Exceptions: Request the floating-day change via the HR portal; managers approve per team needs. If you27re in a timezone where Juneteenth falls on a non-workday, People Ops can advise on a suitable substitute.

patricia: Thanks everyone. Summary: Juneteenth is now a company-paid holiday for US hubs, global floating option available, volunteer stipend available, limited essential coverage only, DM People Ops or Facilities for access or exceptions. We'll publish formal policy doc and a short FAQ by next week.
